definitions.explanation: A male student, typically at the university or high school level. Used in formal or institutional contexts such as statistics, regulations, and news reports.

examples.japanese: {男子学生|だんしがくせい}の{割合|わりあい}は{約|やく}60%だ。
その{大学|だいがく}では{男子学生|だんしがくせい}と{女子学生|じょしがくせい}の{数|かず}がほぼ{同|おな}じだ。
examples.english: At that university, the numbers of male and female students are almost equal.

examples.japanese: アンケートに{答|こた}えた{男子学生|だんしがくせい}の{半数|はんすう}が、{将来|しょうらい}は{海外|かいがい}で{働|はたら}きたいと{答|こた}えた。
examples.english: Half of the male students who responded to the survey said they want to work abroad in the future.

notes:
Composed of {男子|だんし} (male/boy) and {学生|がくせい} (student). While {学生|がくせい} alone is gender-neutral, {男子学生|だんしがくせい} explicitly specifies male gender. Common in formal and statistical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男子学生|だんしがくせい}{寮|りょう}: men's dormitory
- {男子学生|だんしがくせい}の{比率|ひりつ}: ratio of male students
- {男子学生|だんしがくせい}{向|む}け: aimed at male students

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {女子学生|じょしがくせい}: female student — the counterpart
- {男子生徒|だんしせいと}: male pupil — used for middle and high school students
- {大学生|だいがくせい}: college student — gender-neutral
